title: Course of treatment in specialized pain medicine
summary: The aim of this project is to investigate how the health and progression of certain patients' condititons change.  The German pain questionnaire will be used to record how severe the pain is and how it develops over time.

interventions.name:
Register for the collection of routine data in pain medicine
Incidence of relevant pain reduction (at least 30% pain reduction based on the Numerical Rating Scale over the course of 12 months) 
- Quantitative psychometrics (validated German Pain Questionnaire, (Pfingsten et al., 2015)) 
- Qualita

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Patients with presentation in the specialized pain medicine of the Charité CCM and CVK 
- own ability to consent to the study and written consent
Exclusion criteria:
- Placement in an institution by court or official order
- no adequate communication in German possible
